{{Quote|The mortar gun lobs shells that explode on impact.|Jan Ors|<ref name="Coded Transmissions">''[[Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions]]''</ref>}}
The '''Packered mortar gun''', or '''PMG''', was a [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] weapon utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The mortar gun could quickly fire a barrage of explosive shells with a wide explosive radius in an arced trajectory. The weapons were stocked in various Imperial bases and supply caches. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]] commandeered Packered mortar guns during his campaign to stop the [[Dark Trooper Project]], effectively using the weapons against their original owners. Katarn first used one against Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during his [[Mission to Orinackra|mission]] to [[Orinackra]], where he stormed a [[Imperial Detention Center|prison complex]] in order to rescue the Imperial informant [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].

==Description==
The Packered [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] gun,<ref name="Coded Transmissions" /> also known as the PMG,<ref name="Academy" /> fired explosive shells<ref name="Coded Transmissions" /> and cost 120 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Academy" /> The weapon was cylindrical, featuring a large-bore barrel. Three ammunition tubes, attached to the midsection, rotated each [[Time/Legends|time]] the weapon fired. The thin stock had a flat end to rest against the user's body, while the trigger, protected by a trigger guard, was located in front of the stock. A perforated shroud covered the barrel. The weapon had a predominantly [[Color/Legends|chrome]] finish, with dark-gray portions between the stock and barrel. Hooks behind the barrel shroud allowed users to attach a sling to the weapon.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

The weapon offered two primary methods of use. The first involved holding and firing the gun like a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]].<ref name="Dark Forces" /> Alternately, the end of the stock could rest against the user's thigh, allowing the weapon to be fired with one [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=1995 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 3|cardname=LucasArts 4|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/82502/cid/6590883/1995-Topps-Star-Wars-Galaxy-3---LucasArts-Foil-L4-Keith-Carter}}</ref> The Packered mortar gun fired silver shells with brass-colored linings and a red tip, which were lobbed in an arc. The farthest firing distance was achieved by holding the weapon at a forty-five-degree angle.<ref name="Dark Forces" /> Although the weapon served as an alternative to [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], the mortar's shells were actually weaker. Still, the weapon was useful against a wide range of foes and could potentially render multiple tight-knit targets inoperable with a single shell.<ref name="Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|You know as well as I do that the Rebellion is low on resources and most of these go straight to the front, so on this type of operation we have to scrounge what we can from the Empire.|Jan Ors advises Kyle Katarn to use the Empire's weapons against them|<ref name="Coded Transmissions" />}}
[[File:Kyle_with_guns.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Kyle Katarn assaults the Orinackra prison with a Packered mortar gun.]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized Packered mortar guns during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Stocks of the weapons were located<ref name="Dark Forces" /> on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="Encyclopedia-Empire">{{SWE|locations|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and in the [[Imperial Detention Center]] on the world of [[Orinackra]], along with many other locations.<ref name="Dark Forces" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]] briefly described the weapon in a coded transmission to [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="Coded Transmissions" />

Shortly after, the Empire began the [[Dark Trooper Project]], an initiative to create [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] surreptitiously exposed information about the project to the Alliance, which eventually led Imperial authorities to arrest and issue Madine a sentence on Orinackra. Katarn, who had been making waves in disrupting the project with Madine's information, set out to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] to [[Mission to Orinackra|rescue]] him.<ref name="Dark Forces" /> During the rescue, Katarn came across a Packered mortar gun and used it inside the prison against the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]]<ref name="Topps" /> on his way to freeing Madine. Katarn was able to carry up to fifty mortar shells at a time.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Dark Forces}}
Afterward, Katarn continued to use the Packered mortar gun throughout the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] campaign, fighting through scores of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]], and Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in various Imperial installations. The weapon also accompanied Katarn during a [[Mission to Cal-Seti|mission]] to the [[Ramsees Hed]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet [[Cal-Seti/Legends|Cal-Seti]]; a brief [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Dark Trooper campaign)|tenure]] aboard the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], the personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]; a [[Mission to Coruscant (Kyle Katarn)|mission]] to the [[Imperial Security Operations]] building on the planet Coruscant; and an [[Mission to Fuel Station Ergo|excursion]] to the [[Fuel Station Ergo/Legends|Fuel Station Ergo]]. Katarn eventually [[Mission to the Arc Hammer|infiltrated]] the dark trooper [[factory ship]] ''[[Arc Hammer]]'' and destroyed the project.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I like Packard cars, what can I say? Sounded cool. This mortar gun is another favorite of Kyle's. He used this thing heavily when he freed Jan from her imprisonment.|Justin Chin|<ref name="Dark Forces FAQList">{{WebCite|url=http://www.geocities.com/darkforces_faq/dftext2.html|text=Dark Forces FAQList|work=[[Wikipedia:GeoCities|GeoCities]]|archivedate=20010422001343|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:First_Person_PGM.png|thumb|right|180px|First-person view of the Packered mortar gun, showing the shell tubes mid-rotation]]
The Packered mortar gun was created for the [[1995]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'',<ref name="Dark Forces" /> and it later featured in artwork for the ''[[1995 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 3]]'' trading card set, which served as promotional material for the game.<ref name="Topps" /> [[Justin Chin]], the game's story writer, named the Packered mortar gun after one of his favorite automobile companies, [[Wikipedia:Packard|Packard]]. According to Chin, Kyle Katarn personally favored the mortar gun and used it extensively when rescuing Jan Ors from Imperial imprisonment,<ref name="Justin Chin">{{WebCite|url=http://members.shaw.ca/kloepel/DarkForces/dftext2.html#DF51|text=Dark Force FAQ|author=Loepelmann, Karsten A.|work=[http://members.shaw.ca/kloepel/DarkForces/index.html Dark Forces FAQList]|quote=I like Packard cars, what can I say? Sounded cool. This mortar gun is another favorite of Kyle's. He used this thing heavily when he freed Jan from her imprisonment.|archivedate=20160505200427}}</ref> as told in ''[[Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions]]''. However, no ''Dark Forces'' source material, including ''Coded Transmissions'', mentions Chin's details regarding Katarn.<ref name="Coded Transmissions" />

At least one ''Dark Forces'' game tester referred to the weapon as "smoke" during development, having favored other weapons over the launcher. Level designer [[Brett Tosti]] purposely placed a Packered mortar gun underneath a ledge where a thermal detonator-tossing [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] was stationed during the game's Cal-Seti mission. Tosti felt that the weapon was most useful for that encounter.<ref name="Guide" />
